init.header: supervisor init — values read from this machine (key · value · source)
init.exists: already exists: {path} — rerun with --force to overwrite (the previous one goes to {path}.bak)
init.shim_written: shim installed: {path} (resolves the plugin root at every call)
prereq.header: prerequisites (what is missing, and the command to install it here)
prereq.claude_windows: {path} is the Windows Claude Code, reached through the Windows PATH: sessions need Claude Code installed inside WSL
prereq.relay_crypto_missing: Python module {module} not found — needed only by the relay for the phone and watch apps
prereq.relay_crontab_missing: crontab not found — needed only by the relay for the phone and watch apps (relay install)
prereq.firebase_missing: Firebase CLI (firebase) not found — needed only by relay setup, for the phone and watch apps
prereq.no_pkg_manager: no known package manager found: install {what} with your system's tools
prereq.terminal_macos: Terminal and iTerm2 are recognised when init runs inside them: run supervisor init --yes --force from one of them
prereq.terminal_chromeos: the Terminal app is reached through garcon, part of the Linux development environment (Settings → Developers)
prereq.terminal_wsl: install Windows Terminal (winget install Microsoft.WindowsTerminal), then supervisor init --yes --force; without it, open a session with tmux attach -t =<name>
prereq.terminal_linux: install gnome-terminal or kitty, then supervisor init --yes --force; without one, open a session with tmux attach -t =<name>
doctor.no_config: no configuration file at {path}: defaults apply
doctor.backend_none: backend “none”: no window will be opened (headless)
doctor.cb_missing: chrome-bridge CLI not found at {path}: tile/merge/move unavailable
doctor.fix_cb: point tile.chrome_bridge_cli at chrome-bridge's cli.js, or leave it empty to disable
doctor.relay_local: relay in local mode (relay.firebase_url empty): the web app of `supervisor relay web` on this PC; for the phone away from home `supervisor relay setup`
doctor.crypto_missing: Python module {module} not found: the relay cannot encrypt (pair, push, serve)
doctor.fix_crypto: pip install --user cryptography, or apt install python3-cryptography
doctor.crontab_ok: crontab {path} (relay install writes its lines there)
doctor.crontab_missing: crontab not found in PATH: relay install cannot write its cron lines
doctor.firebase_app_ok: the watch's Firebase app: project {project} ({source}) — relay pair shows the QR
doctor.firebase_app_missing: Firebase app data missing ({why}): relay pair shows no QR, the six-digit code stays
doctor.fix_firebase_app: relay.firebase_app with api_key, project_id and app_id in the config, or relay.google_services = path of the app's google-services.json
doctor.shim_not_in_path: {dir} is not in PATH: the `supervisor` command is not found by name
doctor.fix_shim_path: add to your .bashrc or .zshrc: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" — then open a new terminal
doctor.cb_unset: tile.chrome_bridge_cli empty: tile/merge/move will report “requires chrome-bridge”
doctor.hook_dup: account “{account}”: local-time hook also in {path} (with the plugin it arrives twice)
doctor.fix_hook_dup: at cut-over remove that hook from settings.json (back it up first)
doctor.legacy: legacy scripts present in {path}: parallel-trial mode
doctor.shim_missing: shim {path} missing: `supervisor` is not on the shell PATH
cli.unported: supervisor {cmd}: not ported yet (phase {phase} of the plan). Today: {legacy}
shim.unresolved: supervisor: plugin root not found. Set CC_SUPERVISOR_ROOT, or plugin_root in the configuration, or install the plugin (claude plugin install supervisor@...)
sessions.abandoned: stuck on a question, nobody watching
sessions.abandoned_hint: {n} stuck on a question with nobody attached: closing it interrupts no work in progress, only work already stopped.
sessions.tmux_dead: WARNING: the tmux server is not responding. The sessions above keep running, but cannot be driven from outside any more (no talk, no restart).
sessions.footer_native: native channel:  SendMessage (or @name in the prompt) — same peer registry; notify_when_idle tells you when that session is done
sessions.footer_talk: talk channel:    supervisor talk <name> "the prompt" — for sessions outside the registry
sessions.columns: PID ACCOUNT NAME STATE FOLDER WINDOW CHANNEL UPTIME VERSION
sessions.outdated: * = older than {version} on disk: a session picks up the new version only when it restarts (supervisor restart arm, from inside)
sessions.fallback: fell back to {to} instead of {was} (flagged message{why}); to go back: {back}
attach.missing: supervisor attach: no such session: {name}. Running:
terminal.backend_unknown: supervisor: unknown terminal backend “{backend}” (chromeos, gnome, kitty, iterm2, macos-terminal, wt, none)
quota.header: ACCOUNT          5 H    WEEK       WEEKLY RESET      READING
quota.window_expired: WARNING: for “{account}” the week has already reset: the percentage belongs to the closed week and says nothing about the current one. A turn on that account is needed.
quota.old_note: Readings marked (old) date from that account's last session: they refresh only when one runs.
quota.missing_note: An account without data is not an account at zero: no session with the statusline active has run on it yet.
quota.low_priority: «{account}»: {n} session(s) in lower-priority mode (/low-priority): past the limit, slow but alive
launch.auto_switched: {from} is past its auto-switch threshold: the session starts on {to}
launch.usage: usage: supervisor launch <absolute path> [--create] [--continue|--resume <id>] [--account N] [--no-window] [--bg] [--profile N]
launch.resume_needs_id: supervisor launch: --resume needs the conversation id
launch.continue_xor_resume: supervisor launch: --continue and --resume exclude each other: -c takes the latest conversation, --resume a specific one. Pick one.
launch.not_absolute: supervisor launch: an absolute path is required, got: {path}
launch.legacy_flag: supervisor launch: {flag} is the historical name: it means --{account}
launch.account_mismatch: supervisor launch: warning — the path says “{deduced}”, you asked for “{asked}”. Proceeding as asked.
launch.no_tmux: supervisor launch: tmux is not installed
launch.no_claude: supervisor launch: claude not found — tried: {tried}
launch.agent_off: supervisor launch: --agent {agent} is an experiment, off by default: set experimental.{agent} to true in the configuration to try it
launch.unknown_agent: supervisor launch: unknown agent “{agent}” (claude, or codex when experimental.codex is on)
launch.no_codex: supervisor launch: codex not found — tried: {tried}
launch.agent_no_bg: supervisor launch: --bg works only with Claude Code
launch.missing_dir:
supervisor launch: the directory does not exist: {path}
  pass --create to create it
launch.not_a_dir: supervisor launch: exists but is not a directory: {path}
launch.resume_missing:
supervisor launch: no conversation “{id}” for this directory.
  looked in: {dir}
launch.bg_howto:
follow it: claude agents (Ctrl+F or filter n:{name}, Enter opens the best match)  ·  claude attach <id>  ·  claude logs <id>
  stop it:   claude stop <id>
  prompt it from a terminal: claude --resume <id> "prompt" (opens the session in that terminal; refused without one)
  from another session: ListAgents -> SendMessage {{"to": "{name}"}}  ·  from a script: supervisor talk {name} "prompt"
launch.died:
supervisor launch: session “{name}” died right after starting.
  try by hand: cd {dir} && claude
launch.stuck_dialog:
supervisor launch: session “{name}” is stuck on a dialog (trust/permissions).
  answer by hand: tmux attach -t ={name}
launch.window_attached: window open and attached · tmux attach -t ={name}
launch.window_failed: WINDOW NOT OPENED (two attempts): open it by hand with  tmux attach -t ={name}
launch.window_skipped: no window (backend none or no display) · tmux attach -t ={name}
launch.slow_screen: screen slow to draw and registry not written yet: check it is not stuck on a dialog
launch.needs_person: the session is waiting for you (sign-in, first start or trust question): answer it in its window, or tmux attach -t ={name}
launch.no_link: find it by folder in the app's list: the link is not in the registry yet
launch.too_many: supervisor launch: {n} sessions already at work (sessions.max_sessions cap = {max}), free memory {free} MB: each session weighs ~350 MB.
launch.too_many_stop: supervisor launch: not opened. Close an idle session (supervisor sessions marks them) or repeat with --force.
launch.too_many_noninteractive: supervisor launch: not opened (no terminal to ask). Close an idle session (supervisor sessions marks them) or repeat with --force.
close.attached:
supervisor close: “{name}” is OPEN — someone is looking at it.
  if it is a forgotten window of yours, rerun with --dry-run to see, or close it from inside with /exit.
close.self: supervisor close: “{name}” is this session: it does not close itself (restart is there to start again)
close.attached_busy: supervisor close: “{name}” is open and not idle ({state}): not closing it. Wait for it to finish, or answer its question.
close.attached_no_tab: supervisor close: “{name}” is open in a window, but its tab cannot be found for sure ({why}): not closing it. Close its Terminal tab by hand.
close.attached_still: supervisor close: closed the tab of “{name}”, but the session is still alive (maybe open in another window too): not forcing it.
close.none_abandoned: no detached session stuck on a question
talk.enter_again: talk: the prompt was still on {name}'s input line: Enter pressed once more
talk.usage: usage: supervisor talk <name> "prompt" [--wait S] [--quiet S] [--no-wait] [--force] [--reopen] [--via auto|socket|tmux]
interrupt.usage: usage: supervisor interrupt <name> [--wait S]   (one Esc, only while a turn is running; --wait: wait up to S seconds for the turn to start)
interrupt.still: {name}: Esc sent, but the turn is still running
talk.missing: supervisor talk: no such session “{name}”. Running:
talk.self: supervisor talk: “{name}” is this very session: a prompt to itself would land mid-turn
talk.native_hint: supervisor talk: “{name}” shares your peer registry: from a Claude session the native channel is better (ListAgents → SendMessage, with notify_when_idle). Proceeding anyway (NATIVO=no to silence this).
talk.no_tmux: supervisor talk: “{name}” is not in tmux and has no socket: it cannot be driven from outside
hook.waiting_for_you: Waiting for you: {items}. Tell the user, briefly, even if you are talking about something else.
needs_you.usage: usage: supervisor needs-you "<what you need from the user>" [--until "<command that exits 0 once done>"] [--expires 2h] [--task ID] | --clear
needs_you.no_session: supervisor needs-you: run it from a session in tmux
tasks.unchanged: Commitments: {n}, {stalled} stalled (unchanged: `supervisor task impegni` lists them)
tasks.next_approved: {session} resumes and closes with task done {task}
resume_quota.left: note:      Claude Code's resume cost warning (about {pct}% of the 5-hour limit): left to whoever watches {name}'s window
resume_quota.off: note:      {name} is stopped on the resume cost warning (about {pct}% of the 5-hour limit); resume_quota.windowless = off
resume_quota.new: note:      {name}: resuming cost about {pct}% of the 5-hour limit; started a new conversation, with a pointer to the previous one
resume_quota.asked: note:      {name} is stopped on the resume cost warning (about {pct}% of the 5-hour limit): asked you (needs-you)
resume_quota.reason: Claude Code warning: resuming the conversation uses about {pct}% of the 5-hour limit. Choose Resume or Start a new conversation (supervisor answer)
resume_quota.pointer: Pointer from supervisor: this session was meant to resume conversation {sid} in {folder}; resuming it cost about {pct}% of the 5-hour limit, so a new conversation started. Transcript of the previous one: {transcript}. Do not read it now: look it up only if a later message needs it. Reply only "ok".
talk.saved: supervisor talk: “{name}” is closed; message {id} saved in its inbox, delivered when it starts again (status: supervisor talk --status {id})
talk.reopening: supervisor talk: “{name}” is closed: reopening it ({how}) and delivering
inbox.header: MESSAGES THAT ARRIVED WHILE YOU COULD NOT RECEIVE THEM ({n}):
inbox.unknown: supervisor inbox: no message with id “{id}”
inbox.cancelled: message {id} for “{to}” cancelled: it will not be delivered
inbox.not_pending: supervisor inbox: message {id} for “{to}” is {status}, not pending: nothing to cancel
talk.socket_failed: supervisor talk: delivery to the socket of “{name}” failed: {error}
talk.socket_fallback: supervisor talk: socket of “{name}” unreachable ({error}): falling back to tmux
talk.timeout: ── ({s}s cap reached: the session is still working)
wait.goal: goal still open: «{goal}» ({n} checks so far): stopped on «Goal paused», not finished
report.no_project: supervisor report: no folder for “{project}”. Similar:
report.not_delivered: session “{name}” absent and --no-launch: the text was not delivered.
report.followup: the session is reading it; for the outcome look at its window, ask “news?” or use `supervisor wait {name}`
doctor.inbound_held: account “{account}”: without `crossSessionInbound: accept` in its settings, `talk` (socket) messages stay HELD pending confirmation
doctor.fix_inbound: add "crossSessionInbound": "accept" to the account's settings.json (applies to sessions started afterwards)
restart.usage: usage: supervisor restart arm [--clean|--switch-account [NAME]] | list | hook | failed | exec <flag>
restart.not_in_tmux: supervisor restart: this session is not running in tmux, no automatic restart
restart.no_tmux_id: supervisor restart: cannot identify the current tmux session
restart.no_session_id: supervisor restart: CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID missing, no conversation to resume
restart.which_account: supervisor restart: more than one account possible, name it: --switch-account <name> (known: {known})
restart.armed_switch: ACCOUNT SWITCH: restarts on “{account}” resuming conversation {sid} — from then on the context goes to the API under the other organization
restart.switch_not_asked: supervisor restart: --switch-account refused. An account switch sends the conversation to the API under the other organization, and only the user decides it, with a message of their own asking for it (e.g. “switch to the work account”). An answer to a question from the model is not enough. Do not propose the switch: ask the user to write it, if they want it.
restart.armed_clean: CONTEXT CLEARED: restarts without -c (memory on disk untouched)
restart.armed_when: fires at the end of the turn; outcome and link in {log}
restart.in_progress: restart in progress — the session closes and restarts resuming the conversation; link in {log}
queue.scheduled: {name}: queued for {t}; it gets it at the first stop after then, or at {t} if it is idle
queue.added: queued for “{name}”: {n} pending (delivered at the next finished turn)
shell.account_mismatch: note: you are in a folder of account “{expected}” but opening “{asked}” — the typed command stays sovereign.
shell.restore_prompt: machine just restarted: Claude sessions registered before the reboot.
init.shell_written:
shell file written: {path}
  add to your rc (~/.bashrc or ~/.zshrc):  source {path}
next.why_abandoned: stuck on a question, nobody watching
next.why_stalled: busy for {min} min with no change (stalled?)
next.why_recent: finished {min} min ago: outcome to read
calendar.off: calendar off: {path} is missing (one line CALENDAR_ICS_URL=..., mode 0600)
calendar.none: no deadline in its reminder window
next.nothing: no session needs you right now
sessions.stalled: busy for {min} min with no change
sessions.quota_warn: QUOTA: “{account}” has used {pct}% of the week (threshold {threshold}%): consider the other account for new work
sessions.low_priority: at lower priority (past the limit: slow but alive)
sessions.low_priority_offered: at the usage limit: /low-priority offered (goes on slow but alive)
sessions.idle_long: idle for {hours} h: if not needed, supervisor close {name}
park.attached: park: “{name}” is OPEN (someone is watching): not parked
park.busy: park: “{name}” is working: --force to interrupt it
park.no_session_id: park: “{name}” has no conversation id in the registry: it could not be resumed
park.none_idle: no detached session idle for more than {min} min
park.ram_low: free RAM {free} MB < {limit} MB: parking the longest-idle detached session
park.ram_low_nothing: free RAM {free} MB < {limit} MB but no detached idle session to park
cloud.usage: usage: supervisor cloud <dir> "task" [--account N] | follow <id> "message" | desk [start|stop|status] [--no-window]
cloud.in_tmux: still running in “{name}”: attach with  tmux attach -t ={name}  (list: claude agents --json --all)
cloud.tmux_busy: supervisor cloud: tmux session “{name}” already exists (a cloud launch still running?): attach or close it first
desk.disabled: supervisor desk: off by default (desk.enabled = false): the root session is the phone's entry point. Set desk.enabled to true in the config to use it.
desk.died: desk “{name}” died at once: `claude remote-control` does not start (login? plan?)
desk.started: desk “{name}” started in {dir}: from the phone you can open new sessions here without going through the master (without Claude in Chrome: `claude remote-control` turns it on only with --chrome)
restore.as_tabs: tabs in one Terminal window, one at a time — {plan}
restore.no_tty: no terminal to answer here: nothing relaunched. Run  supervisor restore --yes  to relaunch these sessions.
restore.continue_no_id: no conversation id for {name} (or its transcript is gone): it resumes the last conversation of its folder (--continue)
init.tmux_block:
block for {path} (keys from tmux.keybindings; --yes appends it, then `tmux source-file {path}`):
{block}
init.tmux_installed: block appended to {path}: reload with  tmux source-file {path}
tile.needs_bridge: supervisor tile: requires chrome-bridge (tile.chrome_bridge_cli = {path}, not found). Leave empty to disable or point at chrome-bridge's cli.js.
tile.needs_chromeos: supervisor tile: arranging windows requires the ChromeOS Terminal (backend “chromeos”), here the backend is “{backend}”
tile.plan_no_monitor: “{name}” is not among the visible monitors ({known}): it would have to be found by pushing a window against it
tile.move_no_window:
move_tab on {name}: no window id in the reply
{resp}
tile.maximized_detached: {name}: window {state}, reopened in a new window
tile.narrow_stack: stacked column of {px} px, below tile.min_column_px ({min}): the windows on the right are narrow
tile.narrow_grid: {px} px per column is below tile.min_column_px ({min}): grid instead
tile.scattered: sessions scattered over {n} monitors: gathering them on “{where}”
tile.no_monitor_there: no monitor at “{name}”: I did not move. Those I see: {known}. A monitor with no window on it is invisible to Chrome: drag a window there and retry.
tile.stale_monitor:
monitor “{name}” ({w}x{h} at {l},{t}) no longer exists: stale entry removed from the registry.
Retry: the probe will look for it again.
tile.unmeasured: monitor not measurable: tiling within the space already occupied
tile.no_reference:
cannot tell which monitor the windows are on.
Open a browser tab on that screen, or pass --area L,T,W,H
tile.no_home_window: the collecting window did not open on {name}
tile.no_new_tab: window opened but no new tab found
tile.only_home_windows: no window without the start tab: collecting in {win}, which keeps it (the SWA will not close it while other tabs exist). For a clean window drag a session tab out, then run merge again.
tile.tab_window_opened: {name}: no Terminal window with a shell: opened a plain window, the session is its tab (the next ones go there)
tile.tab_plan_new: {name}: no Terminal window: one plain window through garcon, the others as tabs inside
tile.no_source: window {win} has no duplicable tab any more
tile.no_client: {name}: no new tab attached within {s}s — the old ones were NOT closed, the session is safe
tile.no_monitors: no monitor recognized: no maximized window and no browser tab to read it from
tile.where_note: monitors with no window on them do not appear: for those use `supervisor move <place>`, which bumps into them to find them
tile.move_usage: usage: supervisor move <place> [sessions...]   (places: native, left, right, above, below)
tile.layout_missing: warning: sessions present at save time are missing now: {names} — restore repositions only the windows it recognizes
relay.usage: usage: supervisor relay push [--dry-run|--async] | pair [--timeout S] [--text] | serve | web [--no-open] | ensure | status | install | uninstall | off | setup [--project ID] [--dry-run] [--yes] | stats [--since HH:MM] [--until HH:MM]
relay.disabled: supervisor relay: off (relay.enabled = false). Set it to true in the config with relay.firebase_url and the service account.
relay.dep_crypto_missing: relay: the Python module `cryptography` is missing. Install it: pip install --user cryptography (or apt install python3-cryptography)
relay.dep_crontab_missing: relay: `crontab` not found in PATH. Install it: apt install cron
relay.no_sa: relay: no Firebase service account in {path} (0600, never in the repo)
relay.no_key: relay: no key in relay.dir — run `supervisor relay pair` first
relay.no_url: relay: relay.firebase_url is empty in the config
relay.pair_code: Pairing code (5 minutes): {code}   — type it on the watch
relay.pair_code_add: Code (for a watch, {min} min): {code}. On a phone, tablet or Chromebook: scan the QR in the app, or paste the line above.
relay.pair_opened_android: invite opened in the app on {serial}: confirm there «Pair this device?»
relay.pair_clipboard: invite copied to the clipboard (adb: {why}): paste it in the app
relay.web_local_on: Relay on in local mode, without Firebase (relay.enabled and relay.web.enabled in {path}): the web app comes from the site and runs on this PC. For the phone away from home: supervisor relay setup.
relay.pair_web_link:
Web app: {link}
  Secret like the QR: valid for {min} min, the first to open it gets in and the PC accepts on its own. Send it only to yourself.
relay.pair_scan: Scan the QR with the phone app (or type the code below on the watch):
relay.pair_no_qr: no QR: {why} — the six-digit code stays (doctor says how to add the app's data)
relay.pair_qr_narrow: the terminal has {cols} columns, the QR needs {need}: widen it, or use `relay pair --text`
relay.app_unset: relay.firebase_app and relay.google_services are empty in the config
relay.app_file_missing: relay.google_services points to {path}, which does not exist
relay.app_file_bad: relay.google_services: {path} has no project_id, api_key and mobilesdk_app_id for the app's Android client
relay.app_file_many: relay.google_services: {path} has more than one Android client: put the app's package in relay.app_package
relay.pair_failed: pairing FAILED: {n} attempts with a wrong code
relay.pair_timeout: pairing timed out: no watch in {s} s
relay.pair_usage:
usage: supervisor relay pair [--add] [--text] [--timeout S] | --revoke UID
  --add      one MORE device: the key stays, the paired ones stay (at most 4)
  --text     the QR's JSON on one line instead of the drawing
  --timeout  seconds the code is valid (default relay.pair_ttl_s)
  --revoke UID  removes a paired device (uid from devices.json): it reads nothing any more; never the last one
Without --add a new pairing replaces the key and the devices of before.
relay.pair_add_no_key: pair --add: no saved key, nothing to add to — use `relay pair`
relay.pair_add_full: pair --add REFUSED: that would be {n} devices, {max} at most; remove one from devices.json and /allowed, or run `relay pair` again
relay.web_disabled: local web app off: set relay.web.enabled to true (relay.web.dir is optional: without it the web app comes from the site), then `supervisor relay off` and `relay ensure`
relay.web_no_opener: no program to open the browser (xdg-open): open the address above in Chrome
relay.cmd_approve_not_waiting: {task}: no task waiting for an ok
relay.cmd_approve_live_needs_two: {task}: live approval needs a double confirmation
relay.elicit_is_link: {id}: {server} asks to open a link, answer in the terminal
relay.elicit_bad_action: {id}: action {action} not among accept, decline, cancel
relay.approve_wake: {person} approved {task} at {when}: {what}. Go on, and close with task done {task}.
relay.cmd_decision_long: decision too long ({max} characters at most)
relay.decision_to_master: Decision to save in memory, {device}{project}: «{text}». Write it as a file plus one line in your memory's index and confirm in one line.
relay.cmd_decision_inbox: decision in the master's inbox (closed): it reads it when it opens
restart.failed_body: {why}: the session {name} may be down. Launch it again (supervisor launch) or see ~/.claude/ultimo-riavvio.log.
relay.serve_locked: another `relay serve` holds the lock: never two listeners
relay.cron_installed: lines installed in the crontab (ensure + heartbeat every {s} s)
relay.cron_removed: relay lines removed from the crontab
relay.cmd_reopen_done_last: reopened {name} ({account}): last conversation in the folder
relay.cmd_reopen_ambiguous: {name}: conversation unknown and {n} live session(s) in its folder: use launch
relay.cmd_reopen_no_transcript: {name}: the saved conversation ({sid}) is not on disk: use launch
relay.cmd_suggestion_inbox: saved in master's inbox: it reads it when it opens
relay.cmd_suggestion_bad_action: suggestion: the action is accept, later, never, choose or discuss (not {action})
suggest.followup_prompt: A next step left halfway in session {session}, idle for hours: «{step}». If it still holds, send it to {session} with supervisor talk; if not, tell me.
suggest.unsaved_text: {session}: {n} files not committed when it closed
suggest.unsaved_prompt: Session {session} closed with {n} uncommitted files (conversation {session_id}). Reopen it with supervisor launch --resume and have it commit them, or tell me if they stay as they are.
suggest.waiting_prompt: Time to check again the external wait of task {task}: {reason}. If the answer came, resume the task (supervisor task resume {task}); otherwise pause it again with a new date.
relay.cmd_suggestion_chosen: sent to master with the choice
relay.cmd_suggestion_discussed: sent to master to talk it over
relay.cmd_suggestion_bad_choice: suggestion: «{choice}» is not one of its options
relay.suggestion_discuss: Let's talk it over, without doing it:
relay.close_why_background: a job is running in the background
relay.close_why_attached: it is attached to the PC
relay.cmd_no_allow_all: no «don't ask again» option on this question
relay.cmd_high: allow_all is not allowed on a high-tier question
relay.cmd_question_changed: {name}: the question changed after your answer, nothing was pressed
relay.cmd_prompt_queued: queued: {name} is working, it reads it when the turn ends
relay.cmd_prompt_duplicate: {name}: the same message was sent {s} s ago, not sent again
relay.event_quota_auto: {name}: quota limit at night, moved on automatically — {text}

relay.prompt_prefix: From the user via the app. Answer in your own window as to a user message: do NOT SendMessage supervisor or the master. To hand a task to the master, run supervisor talk master "…": the master does not read this window. End your answer with one line «Watch: <the bare outcome, 60 characters at most>»: it is the line the watch shows.
relay.prompt_prefix_legacy: From the user via the watch. Answer in your own window as to a user message: do NOT SendMessage supervisor or the master. To hand a task to the master, run supervisor talk master "…": the master does not read this window. End your answer with one line «Watch: <the bare outcome, 60 characters at most>»: it is the only line the smartwatch shows.
relay.prompt_voice: From the user by voice, in live mode: answer in 2 or 3 sentences, no tables, paths or code; if you propose follow-ups, numbered Prossimi; end with the Watch line.
relay.prompt_prefix_phone: From the user via the phone. Answer in your own window as to a user message: do NOT SendMessage supervisor or the master. To hand a task to the master, run supervisor talk master "…": the master does not read this window. End your answer with one line «Watch: <the bare outcome, 60 characters at most>»: it is the line the watch shows.
relay.prompt_prefix_watch: From the user via the watch. Answer in your own window as to a user message: do NOT SendMessage supervisor or the master. To hand a task to the master, run supervisor talk master "…": the master does not read this window. End your answer with one line «Watch: <the bare outcome, 60 characters at most>»: it is the only line the watch shows.
relay.prompt_prefix_web: From the user via the web app. Answer in your own window as to a user message: do NOT SendMessage supervisor or the master. To hand a task to the master, run supervisor talk master "…": the master does not read this window. End your answer with one line «Watch: <the bare outcome, 60 characters at most>»: it is the line the watch shows.
relay.prompt_handoff: To hand a task to the master, run supervisor talk master "…": the master does not read this window.
relay.prompt_handoff_remote: The master does not read this window: to hand it a task, write in your answer a block that starts with the line «For the master:» and holds the whole task; it reaches the master within a couple of minutes of the end of the turn.
relay.prompt_handoff_remote_legacy: The master cannot be reached from here and does not read this window: write a task for it in full in your answer, and tell the user.
